title: CergioNeedfulPlugin
description: CergioNeedfulPlugin adds most of the commands essential for an SMP server to the game; additionally, it includes a feature that removes mobs and items from chunks that are not currently loaded on the server.
body:
# CergioNeedfulPlugin

An all-in-one teleport and server-utility plugin: TPA, homes, warps, spawn, RTP, back, and kits, tied together with **LuckPerms** integration so cooldowns, home limits, and RTP radius can be customized per rank or per player. Built-in skill leveling, combat logging punishment, and automatic ground/mob cleanup round it out so you don't need five separate plugins doing overlapping jobs.

Messages support **English and Turkish** out of the box (switchable in `config.yml`), use the **MiniMessage** format (gradients, hex colors), and all data is stored in YAML so it survives restarts.

## Features

**Teleportation**
- `/tpa`, `/tpahere` — teleport requests with clickable accept/deny buttons in chat
- `/sethome`, `/home`, `/delhome`, `/homes` — multiple homes per player, configurable limit (overridable per-rank via LuckPerms meta)
- `/warp`, `/setwarp`, `/warps` — paged warp menu with custom icons
- `/spawn`, `/setspawn`
- `/rtp` — random teleport with adjustable radius and a biome blacklist
- `/back` — return to your last location or death point
- Every teleport has a warmup countdown that cancels on movement or damage, and a safe-landing check so you never spawn into lava/void/walls

**Kits**
- `/kit`, `/kits`, `/createkit`, `/delkit`, `/kiticon` — paged kit menu, build a kit straight from your inventory, per-kit permissions and cooldowns

**Skill system (Combat & Mining)**
- Two independent skill tracks, 20 levels each, with a progressively harder XP curve
- XP from mining specific ores and from PvP damage
- Right-click activatable abilities once leveled, boss bar XP feedback

**Combat tag**
- Logging out mid-fight applies a death penalty and drops your inventory
- Separate "death" and "command lock" timers shown on the action bar
- Blocks teleporting while tagged, with a configurable command whitelist

**Automatic cleanup**
- Periodically clears dropped items on the ground, with a countdown warning and sound cue
- Also reaches into currently unloaded chunks to clean those without permanently keeping them loaded
- Clears unnamed hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, creepers, etc.) — nametagged, tamed, or passive mobs (cows, sheep, etc.) are never touched
- Manual trigger via `/cergio cleanup`

**Admin**
- `/cergio reload` — reloads config and messages live, no restart needed
- LuckPerms meta overrides for TPA cooldown, home limit, RTP radius, and more

## Requirements
- Paper/Spigot 1.x (see version selector)
- LuckPerms is **optional** — without it, the plugin falls back to config defaults for all limits/cooldowns

## Configuration
- `config.yml` — all timers, limits, radii, and the `language: en|tr` setting
- `messages_en.yml` / `messages_tr.yml` — fully editable, MiniMessage-formatted message files

## Permissions
See the in-game `/cergio` admin command and the bundled permission nodes (`cergio.tpa`, `cergio.home`, `cergio.warp.use`, `cergio.rtp`, `cergio.back`, `cergio.kit`, `cergio.admin`) for granular access control.

---

Bugs and suggestions are welcome via the issue tracker linked on this page.
